Crock Pot Sunday Roast
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, April 10, 2010 - 1:32am

Ingredients




1 roast (beef or pork)
1 pkg. dry onion soup mix or onion 1 cup water
Favorite spices and herbs
3 potatoes, quartered
3 carrots, cut up

Preparation

1 Load up the crock pot with all ingredients. Mix water with dry soup mix and pour over everything. Cover and cook on high for 5-6 hours or on low for 10-12 hours.
